values.messages.display004:
NeRF: position/view direction → neural network density/color → integration
3DGS: explicit Gaussians → screen projection → sorting/compositing
This example uses analytical Gaussian density instead of a neural network.
values.comments.comment001: This is an analytical 1D density example. It does not train NeRF or run actual neural network inference.

values.note: Compares ray integration through an analytic density field with splat compositing. It does not train or run inference with a NeRF model.
